§8.1 Bullets and Sub-Bullets

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

lists-bullets-and-sub-bullets · lists

✅ Normative

A top-level bulleted item MUST be rendered with the * marker and a sub-item with the - marker. The two markers carry the nesting and MUST NOT be interchanged.

A printed list: items led by a bullet glyph or a number, sometimes with indented sub-items beneath them.

• Top-level item
   – Sub-item beneath it
   – Another sub-item
• Next top-level item

* Top-level item
  - Sub-item beneath it
  - Another sub-item
* Next top-level item

Ordered lists

  • A printed numbering MUST be kept verbatim, including its style: 1. 2. 3., a. b. c., (i) (ii) and 1) 2) differ on the page and MUST differ in the output. The numbering is often cited elsewhere in the document.

Deeper nesting

  • Where the page shows more than two levels, each further level MUST be carried by indentation.
  • The relative structure MUST be preserved: a three-level list MUST NOT be flattened into two.

Lists inside table cells

A cell holding a vertical list is governed by Record Groups and Multi-Line Cells§9.5.3: <ul><li> and <br>• both conform inside a cell, and parallel lists across several columns of one row MUST NOT be collapsed — they become one row per printed line.

Bridge text between lists

An unbulleted line printed between two runs of bullets, such as partially offset by, MUST be rendered as a paragraph between the two lists. It MAY be rendered as indented continuation text only when it belongs to one specific list item.

✅ Sample — a line between bullets that is not a bullet

Four bulleted increases, then partially offset by on its own unbulleted line, then one more bullet. The interjection is a paragraph between two lists.

Expected Markdown · excerpt

…

GAAP diluted EPS for fiscal 2024 were $11.44, a 6% increase over $10.77 for fiscal 2023. Excluding a $0.51 and $1.28 decrease for business optimization costs in fiscal 2024 and 2023, respectively, and a $0.38 increase for a gain on an investment in fiscal 2023, adjusted EPS were $11.95, a 2% increase over $11.67 in fiscal 2023. The $0.28 increase in EPS on an adjusted basis reflects:

  • a $0.19 increase from higher revenue and operating results;
  • a $0.05 increase from lower share count;
  • a $0.05 increase from a lower effective tax rate; and
  • a $0.02 increase from higher non-operating income;

partially offset by

  • a $0.03 decrease from higher noncontrolling interests.

Bullet glyphs that carry meaning

  • A printed bullet glyph that carries meaning — a tick for acceptable, a cross for unacceptable — MUST be kept as the first content token after the Markdown marker: * ✓ Bank statement.
  • A decorative bullet shape (•, ◦, ▪, ➢) MUST be normalised to the Markdown marker and MUST NOT be transcribed.

✅ Sample — bullet glyphs that carry meaning

Acceptable Financial Documents bulleted with ✓, Unacceptable Financial Documents bulleted with ⊗, side by side. Each meaningful glyph is kept after the Markdown bullet; see Iconography and Symbols§7.3.4. The two captions are standalone subheads over their lists.

Expected Markdown · excerpt

…

Acceptable Financial Documents

  • ✓ Bank statement (checking or savings only)
  • ✓ Bank letter on official letterhead
  • ✓ Letter from organizational sponsor (company, government, scholarship)
  • ✓ Loan sanction letter
  • ✓ Letter from sponsor confirming you will have free room and meals

Unacceptable Financial Documents

  • ⊗ Employment income or salary statement
  • ⊗ Property valuations (real estate, jewelry, automobile, etc.)
  • ⊗ Investments including stocks
  • ⊗ Credit card account statements
  • ⊗ Bank deposit slip
